prologue: My name is Ash Trace. Fifteen years since the lights died — I still see them when I close my eyes.
I wore Monroe's colors once. I don't anymore.
Someone I loved — Mira — was taken to Philadelphia. I follow the chalk north.
Arrows in my own hand, I swear. The war map isn't strategy. It's the only road left.

sectors.title: The Fringe
briefing: THE FRINGE — edge of what's left.
Militia patrols treat these roads like property. I used to walk them in their colors.
Break through. Chalk arrows point north — my handwriting, or a ghost of it.
sectors.clear: The patrol breaks. My chalk's still here. So am I.
sectors.blurb_after: Patrols scattered — Ash's chalk trail north open
radio: RADIO: …Militia sweep on the fringe roads — hold the chalk lines…
ASH (memory): I wrote those arrows. I led people into cages.

sectors.title: Dead Grid
briefing: DEAD GRID — substation country.
Every wire is cold. Every tower is silent. My head still aches near the concrete.
Locals swear something hums below. I believe them. The grid remembers.
sectors.clear: The wires sing. My head splits — but I know which way is north.
sectors.blurb_after: Dead grid… Ash felt the current below
radio: RADIO: …substation dark — do not approach the humming basements…
ASH (memory): The blackout didn't end. It went underground.

sectors.title: Ash Corridor
briefing: ASH CORRIDOR — smoke on the horizon.
Commanders push forward. Orders coordinated. Someone upstream is planning this.
I burned this name into the dirt once. Now I cut through it for Mira.
sectors.clear: They burn the corridor. They can't burn the trail.
radio: ASH (memory): They named it after the fire. Or after me.

sectors.title: Broken Line
briefing: BROKEN LINE — refugee track.
Families fled north until the Militia closed the crossing. I was there. I followed orders.
Mira was loaded onto a Republic wagon. I didn't stop it. I quit that night.
sectors.clear: Families cross because I cleared it. That's the debt. Mira's mark is older than I remembered.
sectors.blurb_after: Crossing open — debt paid toward Mira
radio: RADIO: …crossing sealed — wagons north to Philadelphia only…
ASH (memory): I watched the wagon leave. I still hear the wheels.

sectors.title: Iron March
briefing: IRON MARCH — open ground.
Full companies. Full authorization. They're not patrolling — they're hunting.
Some of them still remember my face from the uniform. Good. Let them.
sectors.clear: The march falters. They know my face. They know I'm coming.

sectors.title: The Last Gate
briefing: THE LAST GATE — last settlement before the capital.
Turn back and live. Push through and the Republic answers.
No reinforcements. Just me — and whatever's left of who I was before I lost Mira.
sectors.clear: The gate opens. Philadelphia waits. No more excuses.
radio: ASH (memory): Past this gate, there is only Monroe.

sectors.title: Philadelphia
briefing: PHILADELPHIA — Monroe Citadel.
President Sebastian Monroe built an empire on the blackout. I once carried his orders.
End this. Find Mira. Or die in the shadow of his towers.
sectors.clear: Monroe falls. The Republic cracks. Mira is still out there. The story isn't over.
sectors.blurb_after: Monroe Citadel — fallen. Mira still missing.
radio: MONROE: Trace. You still chalk roads for ghosts.
MONROE: You wore my colors. You followed my orders. And you still chase Mira?

monroe_phase_taunts: MONROE: Trace. You still chalk roads for ghosts.
MONROE: You wore my colors. You followed my orders. And you still chase Mira?
MONROE: I built a nation for the living. You die for the dead!
death_lines: The Militia writes Ash Trace off the roster. Again.
The chalk outlasts me. Someone else will follow it.
I die within sight of the towers. Mira never knows.
Ash Trace falls. The road to Mira goes dark — for now.
victory_lines: Monroe is down. The Republic cracks.
Philadelphia is free tonight. Mira is still out there somewhere.
No one stops me from looking. — Ash Trace
